title: Tropical Liquid Plant Food
description:
Dosage

1 pump (~2mL) for 0.5L of water.  (The cap is 4.5mm!)

How to Use

1. Fill your watering can.
2. (Optional) Let water sit for 24 hours to reach room temperature and allow chlorine to evaporate.
3. Shake well and add fertiliser to the watering can.
4. Water plants as normal.

Tips

  • Fertilize every time you water to maintain stable soil chemistry.
  • Forget to fertilize? No problem! Just resume next time.
  • Use half the dosage in fall/winter or when plants stop growing.
  • Do not exceed the recommended dosage.
  • Use within 48 hours after mixing with water.
  • Ferns: Use half the dosage (sensitive to over-fertilising).
  • Do not use this fertiliser the first 180 days after repotting with SYBASoil!

*We do not recommend using this as a foliar spray, as residue will build up on the leaves.

Tropical BIO Liquid Plant Food

Tropical BIO Liquid Plant Food delivers fast, organic nutrition tailored for the lush, leafy growth that tropical houseplants are known for. This tropical plant bio fertilizer is designed to mix easily with water, giving your Monstera, Philodendron, Calathea, or Alocasia everything they need to thrive. With every drop, this tropical liquid fertilizer fuels healthy roots, vibrant foliage, and steady upward growth.

Why Tropical Plants Need Specialized Care

Tropical houseplants grow quickly and have higher nutrient demands than most species. General-purpose plant food often cannot keep up. That is why this tropical nutrient solution provides a complete blend of nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium, balanced with trace minerals. As an organic tropical food, it feeds plants in a way that supports natural rhythms, encouraging lush leaves without overwhelming delicate roots.

Quick and Simple to Use

This tropical growth liquid integrates seamlessly into your watering routine. Just dilute and pour, and your plant gets immediate access to tropical organic nutrients. Because it absorbs so quickly, it is ideal during peak growing seasons when plants need extra energy. With consistent use, it reduces the risk of weak stems, pale leaves, or stalled growth. Think of it as a tropical plant booster that keeps pace with your houseplant’s natural appetite.

Benefits of Bio Liquid Feeding

  • Fast-acting nutrition for rapid leaf and stem growth
  • Clean and safe, with no harsh chemicals
  • Perfect for large-leaf climbers and fast-growing tropical varieties
  • Super-concentrated, fertilises 125L of water
  • 100% Bio & Vegan, good for the planet & your plant

This tropical care fertilizer offers a reliable way to keep your green companions looking strong, full, and vibrant.

Clean, Eco-Friendly, and Trusted

Sybotanica creates every SYBASupport formula with sustainability in mind. This tropical bio feeding solution is made with clean, plant-safe ingredients that enrich your plant without harming the soil ecosystem. Trusted by thousands of plant lovers across Europe, it is more than a tropical natural fertilizer. It is an easy, eco-conscious way to help your tropical houseplants reach their full potential.

With Sybotanica, Tropical BIO Liquid Plant Food gives your indoor jungle everything it needs for bold, resilient, and healthy growth.
